DECISIONS:
Q1: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: `scripts/security_pass_skip.py` already left `ai:check-triage` out of `SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS` (the comment at lines 61-63, finding `triage-issue-launders-security-pass-exemption`). The reason was that owner-filed issues built from logs contributors can influence don't show a fix is safe. `ai:workflow-heal` at line 66 has the same problem: three of its four intake sources (default-branch `CI`, `autofix_failure`, consumer `repository_dispatch`) come from logs contributors can influence, and the only check is the `workflow-failure-heal:fp=` marker, which doesn't record where the issue came from. Option A fails closed, needs no new marker or provenance check that would itself have to be trusted, and follows the existing precedent. B and C would add code to the intake and the checker that can also be bypassed, and C leaves two of the risky sources exempt.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - scripts/security_pass_skip.py (`SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS` at lines 64-67; the docstring at line 8 that lists `ai:workflow-heal`; the `ai:check-triage` exclusion comment at lines 61-63)
    - tests covering `security_pass_skip.py` / `decide_security_pass_skip` (locate them with a grep for `security_pass_skip` or `ai:workflow-heal` under `tests/`)
    - README.md row for `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED`, and any agents.md or docs text that describes the heal-issue exemption
    - a changelog fragment at `changelog.d/<issue>-workflow-heal-security-pass.md`
  steps:
    - Remove the `"ai:workflow-heal"` entry from `SKIP_LABEL_MARKERS`. Extend the comment above the table so it names `ai:workflow-heal` next to `ai:check-triage`, gives the reason (heal issues come from CI, autofix-failure and consumer-escalation logs that contributors can influence) and cites finding `ci-heal-skips-security-pass`.
    - Update the module docstring (line 8 and the "OWNER ... workflow-heal workflows" wording at line 15) so it no longer lists `ai:workflow-heal` as a skip label.
    - Change any existing test that expects a heal issue to skip, so it now expects `skip: False` with reason `no skip label`. Add a regression test: an OWNER-authored issue labelled `ai:workflow-heal` at creation, with a valid `<!-- workflow-failure-heal:fp=... -->` marker, does not skip.
    - Keep the `ai:security` path and its tests unchanged.
    - Update the docs that describe the exemption, and add the changelog fragment.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: n/a
  equivalence_argument: Every heal-linked fix PR now goes through the single-issue security pass, so a contributor can no longer get unaudited code merged by shaping the logs a heal issue is built from. That is exactly what the finding asks for.
  reversibility: If release and promotion heal fixes later need the fast path back, a follow-up can add a provenance marker written by the intake (as in option B) and re-add a narrowed entry for it. Nothing in this change prevents that.
